Internship: 
MERN Stack Development Internship:Certificate 2025 
 
Completed a MERN Stack Development Internship focused on developing full -stack web applications using 
MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js. Built responsive and interactive user interfaces while implementing 
robust backend services and RESTful APIs for seamless data communication. Designed and managed MongoDB 
databases to ensure efficient data storage and retrieval. Integrated user authentication and authorization using JSON 
Web Tokens (JWT) and implemented secure password encryption techniques. Developed reusable React components 
and optimized application performance to deliver scalable and user -friendly solutions. This internship s trengthened 
my practical knowledge of full -stack development, database management, API integration, authentication, and 
collaborative software development using Git and GitHub. 
 
Projects: 
Student Activity Management System: 2025 
Developed a Student Activity Management System during my MERN stack internship to streamline the management of 
student activities and records. The application allows administrators to add, update, and manage student activity details 
efficiently. Implemented features for storing, retrieving, and updating data using a structured database system. Built 
responsive and interactive user interfaces using modern web technologies. Utilized the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, 
React.js, Node.js) to create a full-stack web application with smooth data flow between frontend and backend. This project 
enhanced my understanding of full-stack development, RESTful APIs, database management, and building scalable web 
applications. 
Online Complaint Management System (MERN Stack): Demo-Link 2025 
Developed a full-stack complaint management platform using React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and Tailwind CSS. 
Implemented role-based access control for Users, Workers, and Admins with secure JWT authentication. 
Built features including complaint registration, image uploads, worker assignment, and complaint status tracking. 
Integrated Socket.IO for real-time notifications and Nodemailer for automated email alerts. 
Designed responsive dashboards and deployed the application using Vercel, Render, and MongoDB Atlas. 
Tech Stack: React.js, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT, Socket.IO, Nodemailer, Multer.
